s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: MRI brain and orbits showed no abnormality
MRI spine showed nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated red blood cell count

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: MRI brain and orbits showed no abnormality
MRI spine showed nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated red blood cell count

shortlist.label: Acute myeloid leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of leukemia cutis and elevated atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness and cranial nerve involvement

shortlist.label: POEMS syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute progression of symptoms, symmetric lower extremity weakness, and violaceous cutaneous lesions

shortlist.label: Plasma cell leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid and presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions

shortlist.label: Intravascular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness and presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness, urinary retention, and violaceous cutaneous lesions, along with the MRI findings of nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots, is consistent with POEMS syndrome, a rare paraneoplastic syndrome associated with a plasma cell disorder.

rejected.label: Acute myeloid leukemia
rejected.why: While the patient has atypical cells/blasts in the cerebrospinal fluid, the clinical presentation and imaging findings are more consistent with POEMS syndrome.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings do not typically match those of neurolymphomatosis, which usually presents with more focal neurological deficits.

rejected.label: Plasma cell leukemia
rejected.why: The patient's presentation is not typical of plasma cell leukemia, which is a more aggressive disease with a higher burden of plasma cells.

rejected.label: Intravascular lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings do not match those of intravascular lymphoma, which typically presents with more systemic symptoms and multi-organ involvement.
